title: Reconciliation

bankEvidence.description: These examples include one payment for two invoices and one invoice paid in two transfers. Bank recorded means the transaction appears in the uploaded statement; integrity checks remain separate.

documentsFirst.title: Your documents are ready for the statement
documentsFirst.description: Add the statement when it arrives, including at month end. Kredibel will check these documents against its transactions.
documentsFirst.notConfirmedNoCash: Payment has not been confirmed. No bank cash recorded.
documentsFirst.confirmedCashNote: No bank evidence. Confirmed {{currency}} 75.00 cash on 13 Jul: paid at the farm. Excluded from bank totals.
documentsFirst.waitingApprovalNote: Waiting for statement. Approval does not confirm payment.
documentsFirst.chooseConfirmTitle: Invoice PP-201: choose what you can confirm
documentsFirst.chooseConfirmDesc: Approving this invoice confirms the document is valid. Confirming payment records how much was paid and when.
documentsFirst.approvalFeedback: Document approval recorded: payment remains unconfirmed.
documentsFirst.paymentReasonDefault: Paid the supplier; waiting for July's statement.
documentsFirst.auditNotice: This records your confirmation, with no bank evidence. It does not change bank cash totals. A smaller amount leaves a partial payment.
documentsFirst.manualPaymentFeedback: Manual payment confirmation saved: audited with no bank cash created.
